name: kortexa-bold
summary: Statement-led myth-busting on black: huge 3-6 word Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase statements with one lime word, almost no body. MYTH slides state the belief, TRUTH slides answer it in one or two short lines, then steps, a before/after and one lime CTA button.

archetypes.name: hook
archetypes.description: Cover, left-aligned. Tiny eyebrow kicker (e.g. 'MYTH VS TRUTH') with lime bar, then a HUGE uppercase statement of 3-6 words with one **lime** word. No body.

archetypes.name: myth
archetypes.description: Left-aligned. Kicker 'MYTH' with lime bar, then a huge uppercase statement of 3-6 words: the belief, said plainly. No body.

archetypes.name: truth
archetypes.description: Left-aligned. Kicker 'TRUTH', uppercase heading of 3-6 words with a **lime** word, lime bar, then ONE short sentence of body (max 18 words).

archetypes.name: step
archetypes.description: Left-aligned. Kicker 'Step 1', 'Step 2'... becomes a big lime number. Uppercase heading of 3-5 words, one short sentence of body.

archetypes.name: before_after
archetypes.description: Before/after, text only unless the owner sends photos. Heading names the change (3-6 words). Two stacked panels: BEFORE (muted) and AFTER (lime). Write the body as 'Before: <what most agents post>' on one line, then 'After:' followed by 2-5 short lines (newline-separated; lines may start with ✓). No kicker needed.

archetypes.name: cta
archetypes.description: Closing slide, left-aligned, full logo at the top. Kicker 'NEXT STEP' with lime bar, uppercase heading of 3-6 words with one **lime** word, and the body is exactly the call to action ('Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook'), rendered as a lime button with black text.

decorations: full logo top left on cover and CTA slides, small logo lockup top left on inner slides
footer line 'KORTEXA · AI WORKFLOWS' bottom left with hairline divider
letter-spaced lime eyebrow label with a short lime bar
numbered rows with big lime numbers and hairline dividers
callout with lime left border for takeaways
lime CTA button with black text
highlighted words in lime text colour
soft lime glow top right on cover
lime bar along bottom edge on cover
hook_patterns: Myth stated flat, then flipped: 'AI VIDEOS LOOK **FAKE**.' -> 'ONLY IF YOU FAKE THE HOUSE.'
Call out the agent + the pain in one bold line: 'YOUR LISTING ISN'T BAD. IT'S **INVISIBLE**.'
Mistakes count: '5 REASONS YOUR LISTING GETS **NO DMS**'
Contrarian belief: 'YOU DON'T NEED MORE LISTINGS'
Buyer's side: 'THE BUYER MESSAGED **3 AGENTS**. WHO REPLIED FIRST?'
tone: First person 'I' (the founder) talking straight to 'you', the agent. Simple eighth-grade English, short sentences. Confident and helpful, never hype. Lead with the problem, then the fix. Local and specific: Ghanaian areas, WhatsApp, cedis. No made-up numbers, no prices, no guarantees.
caption_style: Five-line formula: 1) hook line restating slide 1 in new words; 2) 2-4 short lines with the key takeaway; 3) a question to spark comments; 4) 'Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.'; 5) 3-5 hashtags such as #ghanarealestate #accrarealestate #realestateghana #eastlegon #realestateagent. No emojis or at most one. No prices.
